## About
Crash Auto Parts is a used auto parts yard on South Fort Street in Detroit. We're here to help you find the right part at a fair price, whether it's a door for your pickup or a whole front end.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 432 Google reviews. Stop by during the week and we'll show you what we have.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used parts for the Detroit area. One customer bought a door for a pickup truck that was exactly what they needed.
- Swapped out wheels: One reviewer said Dan swapped out her wheel and put her original tire back on, no problem.
- Removed and delivered: One customer said we removed and delivered within an hour of payment.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I see a part before I buy it?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we showed her and her dad the parts they were interested in and let them compare.

Q: What condition are the parts in?
A: One reviewer said the parts are in good condition and cheap, too.
